summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Connected Accounts Provider Cards Grid and Settings Panels. All 7 features tested and working correctly. The page shows 3 provider cards (Discord, Telegram, Zendesk) in a grid layout with Connected badges. Clicking each connected provider opens its dedicated settings panel with consistent design. X close button returns to grid view.
critical_code_review_comments: All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Provider cards grid layout is responsive with auto-fill minmax(280px, 1fr)
Connected badges show green checkmark with 'Connected' text
Discord settings panel correctly hides setup guide in edit mode (single column layout)
Telegram settings panel shows ACTIVE badge, Connection card with masked token, Test button, Save/Reconnect/Disconnect buttons
Zendesk settings panel shows ACTIVE badge, Connection card, Integration Status, Response Mode toggles, Save Settings button
X close button on all panels correctly returns to grid view
Telegram Test button correctly calls API and shows error toast for invalid token
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing connected accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Connected Accounts page fully tested with provider cards grid. Key test IDs: provider-card-discord, provider-card-telegram, provider-card-zendesk, provider-connected-discord, provider-connected-telegram, provider-connected-zendesk, discord-setup-panel, telegram-setup-panel, zendesk-setup-panel. All 3 providers have connected accounts in the test org. Telegram Test button returns 'Telegram error: Not Found' (expected with test credentials - bot token may be invalid/revoked).

features_tested.details: Discord, Telegram, Zendesk cards displayed in responsive grid with provider icon, name, description, and status badge
All 3 providers show green 'Connected' checkmark badge (data-testid: provider-connected-discord/telegram/zendesk)
Clicking Discord card opens settings panel with credential fields. Setup guide NOT shown (edit mode). Shows Current Configuration badges and Update Credentials form.
Clicking Telegram card opens settings panel with: header (Telegram + ACTIVE badge), Connection card (masked token + Test button), Update Bot Token field, Save Changes/Reconnect/Disconnect buttons

Clicking Zendesk card opens settings panel with: header (Zendesk + ACTIVE badge), Connection card (midnight-gd.zendesk.com), Integration Status (Active), Response Mode toggles (Auto-Reply, Agent Assist), Save Settings button

features_tested.feature: X Close Button Returns to Grid
features_tested.details: X close button on all 3 settings panels correctly returns to the 3-card grid view
Test button calls POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id}/test and shows toast message. Returns 'Telegram error: Not Found' (expected with test credentials)

features_tested.feature: Account Name and Connection Count on Cards
features_tested.details: Each card shows account name (Discord Bot, TEST_Telegram_Account, Zendesk - midnight-gd) and connection count at bottom

notes: Telegram Test button returns 'Telegram error: Not Found' because the bot token stored in the test account is invalid/revoked. This is expected behavior - the UI correctly displays the error message from the Telegram API.
